disposition: Additive VP-07 only. VP-01…VP-06 registers unchanged. VP06_* codes from the frozen facade pass through unchanged (Path F, flow panels). VP-07.1 (0.7.1) adds VP07_DECLARED_GAP only; existing codes keep their meaning and gain the 0.7.1 situations of VP07_1_ACCEPTANCE_SPEC.md §2. VP-07.2 (0.7.2) adds VP07_LAYER_UNASSIGNED only. VP-07.3 (0.7.3) adds VP07_METHOD_UNKNOWN and VP07_METHOD_ARGUMENT_HIDDEN only. VP-07.4 (0.7.4) adds no code; existing codes gain the 0.7.4 situations of VP07_4_ACCEPTANCE_SPEC.md §2.

codes.reference_rule: VP-07 PV-2, §2: < 2 steps, duplicate step, cell steps out of declared order or not contiguous
VP-07 §2: cell or transition references an unknown row, object or step
VP-07 PV-1, D-1: rows/cells/lanes over budget with reject, any overflow at detail, or too many steps; 0.7.1 D-4: more than 4 transitions at one step boundary
VP-07 PV-7: cube.phases is lens neutral only in 0.7.0
VP-07 §1.1 plan structure (keys, profile, IDs, labels, declaration_ref scope)
VP-07 PV-5, D-7; mirrors P1.10 P1_MIGRATION_DANGLING_DEPENDENCY visually; never a verdict
VP-07 PV-5, D-7; mirrors P1.10 P1_MIGRATION_PREMATURE_DEPENDENCY visually; never a verdict

VP-07.1 GM-1…GM-5, D-7; cell ends before the target step without retirement of object or subject, successor, drop or listed end reason; mirrors P1.10.1 P1_MIGRATION_DEPENDENCY_GAP visually; never a verdict
VP-07.2 D-4, LS-3: a shown referent has no entry in the declared layer map and is placed in the trailing layer unassigned; never a verdict
VP-07 ES-1, ES-3: style outside closed set, predicate styled twice, legend missing or > 40
VP-07 §2: predicate without style entry rendered solid, legend row unstyled
VP-07 ES-4, D-9: styled print envelope structure

VP-07 PE-1, PE-2: undeclared partition key, missing lens/track, or one group exceeds the panel budget; 0.7.1 NP-1: more than two keys, repeated key, step as outer key for cube.flow, nested partition on a 0.7.0 source, inner group over budget (message names outer and inner value); 0.7.2: partition layer on a source without declared layers; 0.7.4 PM-1: partition method on a source without method fields (below 0.7.3), or a method group that exceeds the budget even after the split by subject

VP-07 PE-3, PE-6: union of panels incomplete, or file/digest/ledger mismatch in check-panels; 0.7.1 NP-3/NP-4: outer group not covered by its own panels or outer ledger differs from the panel inputs; 0.7.4: methods line or edge methods of a flow panel differ from the embedded source

VP-07 MS-1…MS-3, D-10: not a migration source, above hard limits, or unreferenced rows/objects; 0.7.1 §2: gap fields, target_step or transition codes in a 0.7.0 source; 0.7.2 LS-2: layer fields inconsistent or present in a 0.7.0/0.7.1 source; 0.7.3: method fields in a source below 0.7.3, or a malformed binding

VP-07 AD-1, AD-5: not binding-context/5, unknown plan, empty slice, invalid track/label/prefix map; 0.7.2 LM-1…LM-3, LS-1: invalid layer map, ref in two layers, undeclared ref, reserved name unassigned, layer map with profile 0.7.0/0.7.1; 0.7.3: binding-context/7 with method_profile_refs other than P1.11/migration-methods-v1, or a /7 context with an explicit profile below 0.7.3
VP-07 AD-2, AD-7, D-11: concept without mapping row, ref not a valid display ID without label entry
VP-07 §3.6: internal audit invariant (partition, embedded ledger, no active SVG content); 0.7.4 D-7: the methods line would overlap a drawn element of the flow panel
VP-06 load rules: unreadable, > 2 MiB, duplicate key, nonfinite number
VP-06 PE-5 rule: output never overwritten
VP-06 PE-5 rule: staging or publish failed

VP-07.3 §2 row 2, D-6 (same rule as VP-09.1 D-5): a binding names a method that is neither a P1.11 catalog ID nor a local method contract; message names the method and its declaration_ref (P1.11 itself reports P1_MIGRATION_METHOD_UNKNOWN as UNRESOLVED)
VP-07.3 §2 row 4, MT-3, D-7: a binding argument names a referent outside the slice (--track, --subjects, --steps); the declared ref text is kept and marked hidden, never dropped
